principle: sandbox may fail; reality receives only READY evidence packages

demand_routing.input: structured request or short natural-language demand
demand_routing.production_order: preflight assets and continuity before materializing a production run
demand_routing.provider_boundary: emit the next provider action only after READY evidence; never duplicate an admitted request
demand_routing.delivery_boundary: never mark delivered without an authorized destination

generation_gate.idempotency: same_shot_and_request_hash_is_replayable; conflicting_request_is_blocked unless an explicit revision_of hash is supplied
generation_gate.request_lineage: changed requests create a new revision with supersedes_request_hash; they are never labeled as a transparent retry
generation_gate.execution_identity: production manifest and acceptance receipt must carry the current run_id

delivery_gate.continuity_review: every REVIEW_REQUIRED shot must have PASS_REVIEWED_NO_INTERNAL_CUTS before promotion
delivery_gate.authorization: production delivery confirmation requires an explicit authorized=true acknowledgement
delivery_gate.reality_rule: only DELIVERY_READY or DELIVERED may cross the reality boundary

evidence.format: single persistent JSON run with append-only hash-chained events
evidence.recovery: re-open the run file; never repeat a conflicting submission
evidence.handoff: execution owner and action_id are recorded in the same run; handoff changes owner, never run_id
